children: Bitmine Immersion Technologies terminated its revenue-participation Management Services Agreement with Ethereum Tower effective September 3, 2026, and immediately transitioned to a new advisory services agreement with American Validator effective September 4, 2026. The new arrangement carries a simplified 1.50% fee on staking rewards from Company-staked Ethereum, replacing the prior long-term revenue share model. The company reported no material termination penalties and expects the new structure to streamline costs while maintaining operational support for its Ethereum staking activities.
: Advisory services agreement for Ethereum staking operations (1.50% of staking rewards)
: Simplify fees and continue staking operations

: End revenue participation; transition to simplified advisory model
